name: Toy Boxes and Game Boards: Pastimes of the Modern Age
description: Teddy bears, Lego, Barbie, Monopoly, Mario and Minecraft: the playthings and games that filled childhoods and living rooms from 1900 to the present.

checkpoints.name: Cards and cuddly bears
checkpoints.note: Nintendo begins in 1889 making playing cards. The teddy bear appears in 1902, named after President Theodore Roosevelt. Mickey Mouse debuts in 1928, Monopoly reaches shops in 1935, and in 1949 the Danish company Lego starts making interlocking plastic bricks.

checkpoints.name: Dolls, dice and dungeons
checkpoints.note: Barbie arrives in 1959 and changes the doll aisle. Pong (1972) is among the first video games to reach the public, Dungeons and Dragons (1974) launches role-playing games at the table, and Hello Kitty (1974) begins a career on stationery and toys.

checkpoints.name: Arcades and consoles
checkpoints.note: Pac-Man (1980) and Donkey Kong (1981) fill arcades, and Super Mario Bros (1985) and Tetris (1985) travel home on consoles and handhelds. Toy Story (1995) becomes the first feature film made entirely with computer animation, about toys that come to life.

checkpoints.name: Phones, blocks and birds
checkpoints.note: The Sims (2000) turns everyday life into a game, and Wii Sports (2006) gets families moving in the living room. Minecraft and Angry Birds both arrive in 2009, and Pokémon Go (2016) sends players outdoors with their phones.
